competitors.name: Yough
competitors.action: Launched nationwide in just under 2,000 Target stores with a Greek-yogurt-dough frozen pizza line, alongside a strategic investment from Founders Row.

competitors.name: California Pizza Kitchen
competitors.action: Expanded its frozen retail business internationally with Nestle across Mexico, Central and South America, and the Caribbean, while also signaling broader grocery platform growth beyond pizza.

competitors.name: Blackbird Foods
competitors.action: Expanded its plant-based Pizza Minis nationwide at Sprouts Farmers Market, adding another specialty-retail proof point for differentiated frozen pizza formats.

trends.topic: Differentiated frozen pizza concepts keep winning new shelf space
trends.magnitude: Protein-led dough, restaurant-brand retail expansion, and specialty plant-based formats all advanced in early April 2026
trends.context: The strongest new signals are not generic pizza launches. Retailers are rewarding clear product theses: functional dough, restaurant equity, or distinct dietary positioning.

breaking.headline: Yough lands a near-2,000-store Target rollout with investor backing
breaking.impact: High-conviction retail buyers are still funding and shelving freezer products built around a distinctive dough story.
